definitions.explanation: A soft, watery dish made by cooking rice with extra water until it breaks down. Traditionally served to the sick, infants, and as a light meal.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}のときはお{粥|かゆ}を{食|た}べる。
examples.english: When I have a cold, I eat rice porridge.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{離乳食|りにゅうしょく}にお{粥|かゆ}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made rice porridge as baby food.

examples.japanese: {胃|い}の{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}いので、{今日|きょう}は{温|あたた}かいお{粥|かゆ}にしよう。
examples.english: My stomach isn't feeling well, so let's have warm rice porridge today.

notes:
USAGE:
The お prefix is standard and rarely dropped. A comfort food strongly associated with illness recovery and gentle eating. Also eaten for the {七草粥|ななくさがゆ} tradition on January 7th.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{七草粥|ななくさがゆ} (seven-herb rice porridge) is eaten on January 7th to rest the stomach after New Year's feasting and to pray for good health.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{粥|かゆ}を{炊|た}く (to cook rice porridge)
- {七草粥|ななくさがゆ} (seven-herb rice porridge)
- {白粥|しらがゆ} (plain rice porridge)
